issues.explanation: The adaptation says Zhao Yun kills Zhong Xin but that Zhong Jin merely falls and escapes. In the source, Zhao Yun kills Zhong Jin with one thrust, then kills Zhong Xin with the Qinggang sword; neither survives.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the opening to state that Zhao Yun kills Zhong Jin, then kills Zhong Xin, scattering the remaining soldiers.
